disclaimer: RVHL is a RoadOS specification. It is not ISO-certified or officially approved. Severity levels and advisory speeds are RoadOS proposals.

families.label: Traffic signals
families.description: Signal heads, signal states, police directions and electronic control devices.
escalation: Signal state changes to red or amber within stopping distance
Signal failure or dark signal at junction
Approach speed exceeds safe stopping speed for the remaining distance

speed.notes: Advisory speed may be computed for green-wave or stop-line approach; never shown as a legal limit.

dimensions.notes: Physical dimensions per installation; not specified by RVHL.

families.label: Regulatory, warning & informatory signs
families.description: Fixed road signs: mandatory/regulatory, cautionary/warning and informatory.
escalation: Vehicle approaching faster than the sign context implies
Sign obscured, damaged or detected late
Regulatory restriction applies to the current vehicle type or dimensions

dimensions.notes: Sign sizes are defined by the governing code; values pending verification.

families.label: Road markings
families.description: Longitudinal, transverse and symbolic pavement markings, studs and their condition.
escalation: Marking faded or missing at night or in rain
Marking conflicts with temporary layout
Marking governs a stop or give-way obligation

dimensions.notes: Dimensions are defined by the applicable marking code; values pending verification.

families.label: Road infrastructure
families.description: Dividers, barriers, delineation, lighting and roadside furniture.
escalation: Element damaged, displaced or encroaching into a lane
Unlit or unreflective element at night
Missing end treatment facing traffic

families.label: Road geometry
families.description: Alignment, junction, gradient and cross-section features that change driving demand.
escalation: Approach speed above curve or junction comfort speed
Night, rain or fog reduces sight distance
Heavy or tall vehicle on steep grade or tight radius

speed.notes: Advisory speed derived from geometry is a RoadOS recommendation, never a legal limit.

families.label: Road damage
families.description: Surface distress, structural failures, open utilities and edge damage.
escalation: Depth exceeds vehicle ground-clearance margin
Located in the vehicle's wheel path
Water-filled or unlit so depth cannot be judged
Two-wheeler approaching at speed

families.label: Speed-control hazards
families.description: Humps, breakers, rumble strips and sudden vertical changes — marked or unmarked.
escalation: Unmarked or unpainted hump
Height or profile beyond typical calming devices
Approach speed high relative to hump profile
Low ground-clearance vehicle

speed.notes: RoadOS may compute a crossing advisory speed. It is not a legal limit.

families.label: Temporary obstacles
families.description: Work-zone devices, construction equipment and temporary traffic arrangements.
escalation: Device inside a live lane without advance warning
Fallen or displaced device
Night-time without lighting or reflectors
Workers or machinery active

speed.notes: Work-zone legal limits come only from signs or authority data.

families.label: Stones & road debris
families.description: Loose objects and spilled material on the carriageway.
escalation: Object height beyond ground clearance
Object in the vehicle's lane
Low visibility at detection distance
Material reduces tyre grip

families.label: Environmental hazards
families.description: Water, low-grip surfaces, weather and visibility conditions.
escalation: Water depth unknown or above wheel hub
Visibility below stopping sight distance
Low grip combined with braking or curve
Two-wheeler exposure

families.label: Moving hazards
families.description: Road users, animals and vehicles whose behaviour creates conflict risk.
escalation: Time-to-collision below threshold
Object moving into the vehicle's path
Vulnerable road user
Wrong-way movement

families.label: Visibility & roadside hazards
families.description: Missing or obscured guidance and roadside conditions that hide risk.
escalation: Night-time operation
Hidden element precedes a junction or curve
Encroachment narrows the usable carriageway

families.label: Bridge & special structures
families.description: Bridges, flyovers, tunnels, embankments and slope failures.
escalation: Structural failure or collapse reported
Vehicle height or weight exceeds clearance
Flooding of the structure
Missing edge protection

families.label: Vehicle context
families.description: Ego-vehicle state used to personalise severity and advisory speed.
escalation: Context data unavailable — downstream severity must degrade gracefully

references.policy: RVHL never invents clause, figure, page or sign numbers. Every clause-level field is null until an editor verifies it against the official text and records who verified it and when. Document metadata is marked pending until confirmed against the publisher's catalogue. URLs of kind 'publisher_portal' point to the official publisher, not to the document itself.

documents.title: Convention on Road Signs and Signals
documents.identifier: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals, 1968
documents.publisher: United Nations (UNECE depositary / UN Treaty Collection)
documents.urlNote: UN Treaty Collection status page. Consolidated text is also distributed by UNECE.
documents.scope: International sign classes, shapes, colours and traffic light signals.
documents.licensing: UN treaty text. Pictograms in RVHL are original RoadOS drawings following convention geometry, not reproductions of annex artwork.

documents.title: Code of Practice for Road Signs
documents.urlNote: IRC publications are sold by the Indian Roads Congress; no free official document URL is assumed.
documents.scope: Mandatory/regulatory, cautionary/warning and informatory signs used on Indian roads.
documents.licensing: Copyrighted IRC publication. Do not reproduce figures; RVHL artwork is original.

documents.title: Guidelines on Traffic Management in Work Zones
documents.scope: Work-zone devices: cones, barricades, drums, signs, diversions and lane closures.

documents.title: Guidelines for Traffic Safety Barriers
documents.scope: Roadside and median safety barriers, end treatments and crash cushions.

documents.title: Guidelines for Pedestrian Facilities
documents.scope: Footpaths, pedestrian crossings, guardrails, refuge islands and pedestrian signals.

documents.title: Guidelines for Traffic Calming Measures
documents.scope: Speed humps, rumble strips, raised crossings and other traffic calming devices.

documents.title: Manual on Road Safety Audit
documents.scope: Road safety audit process and typical deficiencies (sight distance, signage, roadside hazards).

documents.title: Code of Practice for Maintenance of Bituminous Road Surfaces
documents.scope: Bituminous surface distresses (potholes, cracking, rutting, ravelling) and their maintenance.

documents.title: Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations, 2017
documents.publisher: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Government of India
documents.urlNote: Published as a Gazette of India notification. Direct gazette URL pending verification.
documents.scope: Driver obligations including obeying signs, signals, markings and traffic police directions.

documents.title: Specifications for Road and Bridge Works
documents.publisher: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Government of India (published through IRC)
documents.scope: Construction specifications including road furniture, markings, studs, barriers and kilometre stones.

documents.title: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices for Streets and Highways
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration
documents.scope: Comparative international reference for signs, markings, advisory speeds and work-zone devices. Not applicable law in India.
